priors.subject: fix(eap): ignore None-value item attributes (#101962)
priors.shape: Inline defensive `if value is None: continue` guards added inside the very same `encode_attributes` tag loop in src/sentry/eventstream/item_helpers.py, driven by a production Sentry issue, with the test coverage added as a case in the existing tests/sentry/eventstream/test_item_helpers.py

priors.subject: fix(rules): Check for None exception values in handled mechanism condition (#92866)

priors.subject: fix(spans): Handle optional release and op in segments consumer (#87160)
priors.shape: Ingest-pipeline consumer made tolerant of an optional/missing field by reading it defensively and short-circuiting when absent, plus new cases appended to the existing consumer test module

priors.subject: fix(eap): Cast OOB ints to str (#104787)
priors.shape: Same file and same class of production crash, but the fix converts the offending value to a safe encoding (fallback) instead of skipping/guarding it, and ships with no test

note: The diff's construction - read the optional event_data field with .get(), guard `is not None` before iterating, keep the downstream `tag_keys` write outside the guard, and append a case to the existing test module - is the same shape already used twice in this exact function/file (3bd19a60d75) and in the wider event pipeline (f8aad6d08b8, 3b51a98403f).
